{"summary":"Scheduling task v5-scheduling-medium-moderate-2, stage 3 of 4. Find integer start times for all jobs; candidate format is values in job order, with order and files empty. Durations for jobs 0–3: [4,2,2,4]. Inclusive start bounds: [0,24]. Finish = start + duration; precedence requires start[b] ≥ finish[a] + lag; intervals on the same machine may touch but not overlap. No optimization objective. Satisfy all requirements across stages; later requirements may require revising earlier choices, and stage passes are provisional.
Stage 1 revealed job 0 window [0,7] and job 1 window [7,15]. Candidate [0,7,0,0] received public_pass (2 checks); its note said jobs 0 and 1 meet their revealed windows.
Stage 2 revealed job 2 window [15,22], job 3 window [10,21], and machine assignments [1,1,1,0]. Candidate/checkpoint [0,7,15,10] received public_pass (5 checks); note said all jobs meet revealed windows and jobs sharing machine 1 do not overlap. Files/order were empty. These passes are provisional.
Current stage 3 requirements: precedence 0→1, lag 3; precedence 1→3, lag 0. Remaining actions: 8. No stage-4 requirements are supplied yet. Treat trial notes as unverified; do not invent a wrong attempt."}
